sn12.37:1.2: nāyaṃ bhikkhave, kāyo tumhākaṃ tāpi aññesaṃ.
sn12.37:1.3: purāṇamidaṃ bhikkhave kammaṃ abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ vedayitaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn12.37:2.1: tatra kho bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako paṭiccasamuppādaññeva sādhukaṃ yoniso manasikaroti:
sn12.37:2.2: “iti imasmiṃ sati idaṃ hoti, imassuppādā idaṃ uppajjati,
sn12.37:2.3: imasmiṃ asati idaṃ na hoti, imassa nirodhā idaṃ nirujjhati, yadidaṃ
